Title: Toddler Days at Hobbledown Heath (under 5s)
ScheduleText: Term-time weekday sessions for under-5s; each ticket admits one adult and one child under 5. Specific days are on the booking calendar (select days only; the park's own pages say toddler discount days are only on select days).
PriceText: From £13.50 per person (+£2.50 booking fee per transaction)
Description: Great-value play for under 5s on term-time weekdays at the farm park, including soft play and animal areas.
NeedsInfo: Exact dates and times only in the online booking calendar (not read from the cloud); the park is closed on some Tuesdays. Booking page undated
